question: Do frozen affine RNNs require within-stage modulation variation, or do fixed stage/global schedules preserve competence, individualized organization and A/C compensation? Independently locate the compact-export numerical mismatch.
tier: Development on exposed references and panels

audit.inputs: Panel1 four generic archives and Liu8. No slow updates. Reset h/E per experience, retain only P. Include initial blank and all four phases; first two support phases must have exactly zero eligibility opportunity.
records: potential Frobenius norm of alpha*old E
absolute discrepancy with mean preceding observed relation evidence
audit.history: Canonicalize q by unordered item pair orientation using only preceding observations. First occurrence count/discrepancy zero. No true order, retention indicator or reliability label enters a predictor or replacement.
audit.descriptive: Separate four phases within each frozen model/observation/input. m quantiles1/5/50/95/99; potential RMS, actual mean, clipping fraction, opportunity-squared-weighted m mean/RMS/sign fractions. No cross-network pooling or variance/fit selection threshold.
audit.prediction: Generic-only leave-one-archive-out WLS, holding both observations of each archive out together. Separately in phases3/4: intercept; intercept+normalized time+signed q+abs(q); preceding terms+repeat count+has previous observation+observed discrepancy. Report weighted prediction errors, not causal effects; Liu is not used.

calibration.source: All eight generic panel1 archive/observation combinations per model. Never Liu. Same constants in both observation conditions for that model.
calibration.phase: Weighted least-squares mean m for each of phases3/4 with weights ||alpha*Eold||_F^2. Each archive/observation weighted equally by normalizing sums by row count. Values for ineffective phases1/2 are0.
calibration.constant: Same weighted mean pooled across both active phases; identical scalar at all support phases. Fitted concurrently with phase constants before any intervention, locked but exposed only if phase gate passes.
calibration.boundary: These are frozen-solution interventions, not trained alternative architectures; weighted mean does not preserve modulation variance or exact actual write budget.

intervention.phase: Replace only m in support P update with fixed phase value; compute h/E with original cell and evolving intervened P. Preserve old E timing, clip[-50,50], alpha, observation and(q,q), all query calculations.
intervention.inputs: Same physical inputs, realized q, choices and intervention identities as affine reference; three seeds x four A0/Ae/C0/Ce cells x panels2/3. Baselines reused by reference.
intervention.constant_trigger: Only if phase passes the all-three-pair preservation gate; then another24units, with previously locked constants and no changes.

decision.primary: Paired intervention-minus-affine generic-global CE interaction. Positive95 lower bound means compensation attenuated by this joint schedule intervention; interpret selective effects only if task competence remains. Do not infer a difference from two separate significance labels.
decision.secondary: Paired changes in tau interaction, S_C-S_A, both noise tau simple effects; complete four-cell competence, core flags, P_off and evidence-shuffle binding. Per-cell paired total-write difference and ratio for generic and Liu, same bootstrap IDs.
decision.statistics: Inherit parent2000 shared-ID bootstrap draws,95% intervals, seed126000+seed+panel*1000000. Equal mean of two fixed panels within each network. No cross-network pooling. Paired complete-case omitted probability preserves included/excluded IDs.
decision.preservation: Unchanged parent eight flags, evaluated on panels2/3: all24cells competent, Ce five correct-probability endpoints lower95>=-.02 for every network, Ae/Ce core each present on at least one of two panels per network, binding all Ae/Ce cells, I_tau lower>0,I_CE upper<0,S_C-S_A upper<0,both noise tau upper<0. All three pairs must pass to trigger constant.
decision.otherwise: Preserve all failures/uncertainty and write changes; stop the next intervention branch. No gain repair, altered tolerance, seed repair or extra panels. Failure does not prove state-dependent architecture necessary; changing marginal write budgets limits attribution to experience alignment.
decision.training_trigger: If global constant also preserves all three pairs, prepare and freeze a separate from-scratch constant-head successor with one trainable signed scalar initialized from each untrained affine bias c0, unchanged common initial tensors/RNG and1500x32 recipe; six A/C models locked before36 evaluations. Do not distill trained-head means into its initialization. If global branch is not triggered or fails, training remains a distinct future necessity test rather than being declared impossible.

compact_diagnostic.scope: Only frozen2533/clean, inferred fifth failing model. Original38D versus pure column merge37D; original input order panels1..3,clean/noisy, sorted archives, intact then Liu shuffle then eight removals. Stop locator at first mismatch; persist case/tensor/indices/values, all five tensor errors and exact choice/order checks for that case. If none reproduces, report nonreproduction without tolerance changes.
compact_diagnostic.propagation: At located case record per-step input projection,h,m,E,P maximum absolute difference and maximum ratio to original tolerance. Three eager diagnostics: float32; float64 after float32 merging; float64 before merging. Preserve reset/update timing. Float64 is diagnosis, never original qualification; standalone compiler warmup may differ from previous stopped export.
compact_diagnostic.boundary: No new checkpoint export, human statistics or original-study rewriting. No six-model qualification or claim that numerical difference is harmless.

execution.freezes: Commit qualified source/protocol, write/commit source and immutable input/model locks before audit. Finish all six calibrations and commit their common lock before any intervention. Do not edit frozen implementation after outcome exposure; source fixes require an explicit successor.
execution.qualification: CPU/GPU independent schedule update, zero-opportunity first two steps, clipping fixture, intact support parity; unchanged2531/A0/panel1 collector105array exact replay; traceP parity on generic test28. No new intervention outcomes in qualification.
execution.checks: Changed-file Ruff/format/types, affected numeric tests and architecture checks; registry/docs/diff. Scoped saved-data verification of paired CE interaction and reported gates, no automatic independent reconstruction of every estimator.

claim_boundary: Frozen-solution dependence is distinct from from-scratch architecture necessity.
Three A/C training pairs; panels already exposed; no independent confirmation or model promotion.
A/E traces are state-dependent even with constant m; constant success would not remove state dependence from learning.
No claim of biological dopamine identity, inferred reliability access, or human distribution fitting.
